rationale: Catalytic kinetics (Km, kcat, Vmax) depend on enzyme identity (item 01) and immobilization (item 02). Cannot freeze until both are resolved.

what_kinetics_we_need.Km: Michaelis constant — substrate concentration at half-maximal velocity. Determines whether CSF Aβ concentration is in the linear or saturated regime.
what_kinetics_we_need.kcat: Catalytic constant — turnover number (substrate molecules per enzyme per second).
what_kinetics_we_need.Vmax: Maximum velocity per unit membrane area. Determines required membrane size.
what_kinetics_we_need.pH_optimum: CSF pH is 7.33. Enzyme pH optimum must match.
what_kinetics_we_need.temperature_optimum: CSF temperature is 37°C. Enzyme must operate efficiently at this temperature.

literature_values_for_NEP_on_abeta.source: Iwata et al., Nat Med 2000; Howell et al., J Biol Chem 1995
literature_values_for_NEP_on_abeta.Km_for_abeta_40: ~5-10 μM (varies by NEP source and assay)
literature_values_for_NEP_on_abeta.notes: These are SOLUTION kinetics. Immobilized NEP typically has 2-5x higher Km and 2-5x lower kcat due to mass transport limitations.
literature_values_for_NEP_on_abeta.status: LITERATURE_VALUES — must be confirmed for our specific immobilized system

csf_abeta_concentration_reference.alzheimer_patient_csf_abeta_42: ~200-500 pg/mL = ~0.05-0.1 nM (paradoxically lower due to brain sequestration)
csf_abeta_concentration_reference.implication: CSF Aβ concentration (nM range) is FAR below NEP Km (μM range). Enzyme operates in linear regime. Vmax not the bottleneck — mass transport of Aβ to enzyme is.

design_consequence: Because CSF Aβ << Km, the rate-limiting step is Aβ transport to the enzyme, not enzymatic catalysis. This means membrane geometry (surface area, flow path length) dominates clearance, not enzyme loading. This is a key design insight that REVERSES the original intuition.
blocking_work_required: Measure: Km, kcat, Vmax for the SPECIFIC immobilized enzyme in synthetic CSF
Model: mass transport of Aβ to enzyme surface (Cussler diffusion model)
Sensitivity: how does clearance scale with membrane area, flow rate, enzyme loading?
constitutional_basis: Article XXVIII — cannot promote kinetics from literature values to design constants without measuring them for our specific immobilized system.
